mapper.sql: id, line_id, provider_direction_id, origin_stop_id, terminal_stop_id, representative_next_stop_id, display_name, active, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO route_direction ( id, line_id, provider_direction_id, origin_stop_id, terminal_stop_id, representative_next_stop_id, display_name, active, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{lineId}, #{providerDirectionId}, #{originStopId}, #{terminalStopId}, #{representativeNextStopId}, #{displayName}, #{active}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (line_id, provider_direction_id) DO UPDATE SET origin_stop_id = EXCLUDED.origin_stop_id, terminal_stop_id = EXCLUDED.terminal_stop_id, representative_next_stop_id = EXCLUDED.representative_next_stop_id, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, active = EXCLUDED.active, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
